lines.en: label karindate5:
I tap on Karin’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Karin 的名字，等着她接。

lines.en: scene black
scene karinseconddate1
Karin and I decide to meet up at the same park as always.
lines.zh: 我和 Karin 决定照旧在老地方那个公园碰面。

lines.en: She spends the first part of the meeting awkwardly running laps around the track and feeling increasingly worse about how I’m doing literally nothing each time she passes by.
lines.zh: 前半段她一直绕着跑道尴尬地跑圈，而且每次从我身边经过，看着我什么正事都不干，她的脸色就越来越难看。

lines.en: Is it a little strange that our meetings are 95%% me supervising her exercise routine? Absolutely.
lines.zh: 我们的会面有 95% 都是我在监督她做运动，这有点奇怪吗？当然奇怪。

lines.en: But I’m not going to complain about something as trivial as that when I’m blessed enough to ogle at her body without worry of any sort of consequence.
lines.zh: 不过既然我有幸能毫无后果地盯着她的身子看，这种小事我就不抱怨了。

lines.en: : Okay...no more running. I’m good for today.
lines.zh: : 好……不跑了。今天就到这儿吧。

lines.en: : Tired?
lines.zh: : 累了？

lines.en: : Not at all. Just...I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 一点都不。只是……我也不知道。

lines.en: : Maybe a little...embarrassed? Is that weird to say?
lines.zh: : 可能是有点……难为情？这么说会不会很怪？

lines.en: : What’s there to be embarrassed about? You’re doing great.
lines.zh: : 有什么好难为情的？你做得很好啊。

lines.en: : Your times have been improving as well. I have no idea how you have this much stamina.
lines.zh: : 而且你的成绩一直在进步。我真不知道你怎么会有这么好的体力。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate2
: Practice...I’ve been doing this almost every day since...well, forever. So it kind of just...developed, I guess.
lines.zh: : 练出来的……从……嗯，很早很早以前开始，我几乎每天都这么做。所以大概就……自然而然地练出来了。

lines.en: : Good for you. Establishing positive routines is impressive.
lines.zh: : 真不错。能养成好习惯是很了不起的。

lines.en: : Personally, I find it hard even coming to[school] every day.
lines.zh: : 就我个人来说，光是每天去[school]我都觉得够呛。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate1
: That’s...not good, you know? You’re a teacher.
lines.zh: : 这……可不太好吧？你可是老师啊。

lines.en: : Barely.
lines.zh: : 勉强算吧。

lines.en: : No no no, don’t say that. I’m sure you’re great. Miku talks about you all the time.
lines.zh: : 不不不，别这么说。我相信你很棒。Miku 老是把你挂在嘴边。

lines.en: : Wasn’t she failing like, every subject before you started helping her out?
lines.zh: : 在你开始辅导她之前，她不是几乎每科都不及格吗？

lines.en: I think that’s more due to the fact that I’ve stopped giving anyone grades below an A but hey, if Karin wants to think it’s due to me being a good teacher, so be it.
lines.zh: 我觉得那更多是因为我已经不给任何人打 A 以下的分数了。不过话说回来，既然 Karin 愿意认为那是我教得好，那就随她吧。

lines.en: : Yeah. I guess I am pretty impressive when you put it that way.
lines.zh: : 是啊。你这么一说，我还真挺了不起的。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate3
: Totally! It kind of makes me wish I was a year younger so I could be in class with you guys.
lines.zh: : 完全同意！弄得我都有点希望自己小一岁，好跟你们一起上课了。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate4
: W-Wait! No! That probably made it sound like I want to spend more time with you, didn’t it?!
lines.zh: : 等、等等！不对！那听起来像是我想要多跟你待在一起，对吧？！

lines.en: : ...Not really?
: I swear that's not what I meant!
lines.zh: : 我发誓我不是那个意思！

lines.en: : I was just trying to say that it would be cool to hang out with Kirin and Miku in class and stuff!
lines.zh: : 我只是想说，能跟 Kirin 和 Miku 在课堂上一起玩什么的会很棒！

lines.en: : It totally doesn’t have anything to do with you! Nothing at all!
lines.zh: : 这跟你完全没有关系！一点关系都没有！

lines.en: : I never said it did?...
lines.zh: : 我又没说有关系？……

lines.en: scene karinseconddate5
: W-Wait! No! That was bad too! Now it sounds like I never want to see you! That isn’t true either!
lines.zh: : 等、等等！不对！那样说也不行！现在听起来像是我再也不想见到你了！那也不是真的！

lines.en: scene karinseconddate6
: I like you!
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你！

lines.en: : Like, teacher-like! Not boy-like! Boy bad! Teacher good!
lines.zh: : 是、是老师意义上的喜欢！不是男生意义上的！男生不行！老师好！

lines.en: : Okay Karin, it’s time to calm down.
lines.zh: : 好了 Karin，该冷静一下了。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate7
: Ugh...I’m literally the worst.
lines.zh: : 呃……我真的没救了。

lines.en: : I’m never going to get used to this, am I?
lines.zh: : 我永远都习惯不了这种事，对吧？

lines.en: : Sure you will. There’s no way you can stay this uncomfortable around me forever, is there?
lines.zh: : 你当然会习惯的。你不可能在我面前永远这么不自在，对吧？

lines.en: scene karinseconddate8
: Th-That’s not it at all!
lines.zh: : 才、才不是那么回事！

lines.en: : I’m really comfortable! I am!
lines.zh: : 我现在很自在了！真的！

lines.en: : Super comfortable! But also not!
lines.zh: : 超级自在！但也不自在！

lines.en: scene karinseconddate9
: It’s just...being out here alone with you makes it feel like a...d-d-d-d-date and stuff...
lines.zh: : 只是……跟你单独在外面待着，感觉就像是在……约、约、约、约会什么的……

lines.en: : And umm...yeah, that probably sounded weird too. I mean obviously it’s not a...date thingy. You’re just doing your job and...
lines.zh: : 然后呃……是啊，那大概听着也挺怪的。我的意思是，这显然不是什么……约会。你只是在做你的工作，然后……

lines.en: scene karinseconddate6
: Uhh...what were we talking about again?
lines.zh: : 呃……我们刚才在聊什么来着？

lines.en: : I think it was about how you’re a year older than the other girls.
lines.zh: : 我想是在聊你比其他女孩大一岁的事。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate1
: Oh...umm...yeah. That’s what I was talking about. Right.
lines.zh: : 哦……呃……对。我刚才是在说这个。没错。

lines.en: : Whoops...
lines.zh: : 哎呀……

lines.en: This girl really {i}does{/i} have a hard time talking to men.
lines.zh: 这姑娘跟男人说话是{i}真的{/i}费劲。

lines.en: Or at least me.
lines.zh: 至少跟我说话是这样。

lines.en: Miku has said in the past that Karin gets like this around every boy, but I have a creeping suspicion that miss co-captain here might actually be warming up to me quicker than anticipated.
lines.zh: Miku 以前说过，Karin 在任何一个男生面前都会这样。可我越来越怀疑，这位副队长小姐对我升温的速度，可能比预想的要快。

lines.en: : So you’re a second-year then, right?
lines.zh: : 那你是二年级了，对吧？

lines.en: : Right! One year to go. Kind of nerve-wracking to be honest. I’m not really sure what I even want to do with my life yet.
lines.zh: : 对！还有一年。说实话有点慌。我其实不太确定自己以后想干什么。

lines.en: : Well you have roughly a year and a half to think about it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你大约还有一年半的时间可以考虑。

lines.en: I lie.
lines.zh: 我在撒谎。

lines.en: Karin has all of the time in the world to think about it.
lines.zh: Karin 有的是时间去想。

lines.en: Everything is going to just reset before she makes a decision anyway.
lines.zh: 反正一切都会在她做出决定之前重置。

lines.en: But it’s my duty in times like this to instill false words of encouragement.
lines.zh: 不过在这种时候，往她心里灌输几句虚假的鼓励，是我的职责所在。

lines.en: I really am a great teacher.
lines.zh: 我真是个伟大的老师。

lines.en: : Yeah...that’s what my parents keep telling me as well.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我爸妈也一直这么跟我说。

lines.en: : They’re great parents, really...but I wish they’d be a little more assertive at times.
lines.zh: : 他们是很棒的父母，真的……不过有时候我希望他们能再强硬一点。

lines.en: : It’s great that they’re so patient with me but like...maybe I need to be pushed in the right direction or something?
lines.zh: : 他们对我这么有耐心是很好，可是……也许我需要有人往正确的方向推我一把什么的？

lines.en: : Why not just become a housewife or something like that? That sounds easy enough.
lines.zh: : 那不如干脆当个家庭主妇之类的？听起来够轻松了。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate10
: W-Wife?...
: Y...Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-You...
lines.zh: : 你……你、你、你、你、你……

lines.en: : Are you-
lines.zh: : 你该不会是——

lines.en: : No Karin, I’m not proposing to you.
lines.zh: : 不是，Karin，我不是在向你求婚。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate11
: THAT’S NOT WHAT I WAS ASKING!
lines.zh: : 我问的不是这个！

lines.en: scene karinseconddate12
: Do...you really think I’m...housewife material?
lines.zh: : 你……真的觉得我是……当家庭主妇的料吗？

lines.en: : I’m obviously a lot more...{i}developed{/i} and athletic than other girls my age, so everyone just normally suggests that I pursue sports.
lines.zh: : 我明显比同龄的女孩……{i}发育{/i}得更好、也更擅长运动，所以大家一般都建议我走体育这条路。

lines.en: : It’s kind of weird hearing such a...ridiculous suggestion from my coach, who I imagined would be pushing me into that field more than anyone.
lines.zh: : 从一个我本以为会最卖力把我往那条路上推的教练嘴里，听到这么……离谱的建议，感觉挺怪的。

lines.en: : You really look at me as your coach? All I've done so far is use the stopwatch app.
lines.zh: : 你真把我当你的教练？我到现在为止所做的，也就是用用秒表应用而已。

lines.en: : Mhm...
: Fact is, I just think you should do what makes you happy.
lines.zh: : 事实是，我只是觉得你应该做让自己开心的事。

lines.en: : Not everything that makes people happy makes money, though.
lines.zh: : 可让人开心的事，不是都能赚钱的。

lines.en: : Athletic careers are one of the hardest to succeed in. And I’m just some random girl who was born with good genes and a good work ethic.
lines.zh: : 体育这条路是最难走通的之一。而我不过是个碰巧生了一副好基因、又肯努力的普通女孩罢了。

lines.en: : There are plenty of other Karin Kanda’s out there.
lines.zh: : 这世上多得是别的 Karin Kanda。

lines.en: : And I think that’s one of the reasons I get so overwhelmed when thinking about what to do from here on out.
lines.zh: : 我想，这就是为什么一想到以后要做什么，我就会那么不知所措。

lines.en: : I figured that’s what was going on, which is why I suggested the housewife thing.
lines.zh: : 我猜就是这个原因，所以我才提了家庭主妇那个建议。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate11
: S-STOP SAYING THAT! MY HEART CAN’T TAKE IT!
lines.zh: : 别、别再说了！我的心脏受不了！

lines.en: : Why? I think you’d make a great wife.
lines.zh: : 为什么？我觉得你会是个很棒的妻子。

lines.en: : WHY?! ALL I DO IS RUN AND...KICK! AND THEN RUN SOME MORE!
lines.zh: : 为什么？！我每天就只是跑……还有踢！然后再接着跑！

lines.en: : AM I YELLING RIGHT NOW? I FEEL LIKE I’M YELLING!
lines.zh: : 我现在是在大吼吗？我感觉自己在吼！

lines.en: : You’re definitely yelling.
lines.zh: : 你确实在吼。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate13
: Ugh...maybe you should invest in one of those shock-collar things and just...buzz me whenever I start saying weird stuff.
lines.zh: : 呃……也许你该去买个电击项圈什么的，然后……每当我开始说怪话就电我一下。

lines.en: That sentence alone warrants like three buzzes.
lines.zh: 光这一句就够电三下了。

lines.en: Do not threaten a perverted man with the opportunity to put a shock collar on a [teenage]girl.
lines.zh: 千万别拿“给 [teenage]女孩戴电击项圈”这种机会去威胁一个变态男人。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate6
: But really, though?...Who would want a wife like me?
lines.zh: : 不过说真的？……谁会想要我这样的老婆啊？

lines.en: : I thought guys normally liked more...petite girls. Ones more...feminine and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我还以为男生一般喜欢更……娇小的女孩。更……有女人味那一类的。

lines.en: : Like...I’ve gotten confessions from girls before, but never a boy.
lines.zh: : 比如说……以前有女孩跟我告白过，但从来没有男生。

lines.en: : I was under the impression I was a little too...intimidating?
lines.zh: : 我一直觉得，自己有点太……让人望而生畏了？

lines.en: : I don't know the right word to use.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该用哪个词。

lines.en: : I think you’re looking for the word ‘cute.’
lines.zh: : 我觉得你要找的那个词是“可爱”。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate14
: C-C-C-C-C-
lines.zh: : 可、可、可、可、可——

lines.en: : You’re going to have to stop reacting that way if you’re ever going to be a wife.
lines.zh: : 你要是以后想当妻子，就得改掉这种反应。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate11
: STOP CALLING ME A WIFE! I’M STILL IN HIGH SCHOOL!
lines.zh: : 别再叫我妻子了！我还在上高中呢！

lines.en: scene karinseconddate8
: I can barely form a...s-s-sentence around boys. No way could I marry one!
lines.zh: : 我在男生面前连一句……完、完整的话都说不利索。怎么可能嫁得出去！

lines.en: : Obviously, it’ll take a lot of work. But I’ve seen how you act with Miku and Kirin before.
lines.zh: : 显然，这需要下不少功夫。不过我见过你跟 Miku 和 Kirin 相处时的样子。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate15
: Wh-What do you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 你、你这话是什么意思？

lines.en: : The first time I met you was in the storage shed after that ball hit the door and Miku...did whatever that thing she did was.
lines.zh: : 我第一次见你，是在那颗球砸到门之后、Miku 做了那件……她做的那件事的时候，就在那间储物棚里。

lines.en: : You knew exactly how to calm her down and what to do to resolve the situation.
lines.zh: : 你完全清楚该怎么让她冷静下来，也知道该怎么解决当时的状况。

lines.en: : I’m an adult and all I was able to do was stand there in shock.
lines.zh: : 我是个成年人，而我当时所能做的只有愣在原地。

lines.en: : So, in a sense, you’re already more mature than I am.
lines.zh: : 所以从某种意义上说，你已经比我还成熟了。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate16
: Those are more motherly qualities than housewife qualities...
lines.zh: : 那更像是母亲的特质，而不是家庭主妇的特质……

lines.en: : Wives are supposed to be cute and...do things for the person they love and...bake.
lines.zh: : 妻子应该可爱，还要……为心爱的人做这做那，还要……烤点心。

lines.en: : What an archaic way of looking at the roles of a housewife. Get with the times, Karin.
lines.zh: : 你对家庭主妇这个角色的看法可真够老派的。跟上时代吧，Karin。

lines.en: : ...I'm sorry?
lines.zh: : ……你说什么？

lines.en: : All that really matters is finding someone whose tastes are in your favor.
lines.zh: : 真正重要的，只是找到一个口味正好对上你的人。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate17
: Easier said than done.
lines.zh: : 说起来容易做起来难。

lines.en: : At this rate, I’m going to wind up marrying a girl and raising a family of adopted children and driving them all to[school] in my mini-van.
lines.zh: : 照这个势头下去，我大概最后会娶个女孩，收养一堆孩子，然后开着我那辆小面包车送他们去[school]。

lines.en: : And on the mantle where our family picture hangs, there will sit a lone soccer-trophy serving only to remind me of the future I could have led if I had just worked harder...
lines.zh: : 而在挂着全家福的壁炉架上，会孤零零地摆着一座足球奖杯，唯一的作用就是提醒我——要是当初再努力一点，我本可以拥有怎样的人生……

lines.en: scene karinseconddate18
: But then one day, my adopted son will be drafted to Manchester United and I’ll be able to live out my dreams vicariously through him!
lines.zh: : 但后来有一天，我收养的儿子被曼联选中了，我就能通过他间接实现自己的梦想了！

lines.en: : He’ll grow old and raise a beautiful family and I’ll become the cool grandma who smothers her grandchildren with affection and lets them eat cereal for dinner.
lines.zh: : 他会慢慢长大，组建一个美满的家庭，而我会成为那个酷外婆——把孙子孙女宠上天，还允许他们把麦片当晚饭吃。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate19
: But then my wife will be diagnosed with a life-threatening illness and be given only six weeks to live.
lines.zh: : 可后来，我妻子被诊断出患了绝症，医生说她只剩六个星期。

lines.en: : And in those final weeks, I will realize that it was never about boys or girls...it was about love.
lines.zh: : 而在最后的那些星期里，我会明白——那从来不是男生或女生的问题……而是关于爱。

lines.en: : And even though I was hesitant and nervous to introduce her to my family at first...we really did have {i}love...{/i}
lines.zh: : 尽管一开始把她介绍给家人时我犹豫又紧张……但我们之间真的有{i}爱……{/i}

lines.en: scene karinseconddate18
: But then! Out of nowhere, my second adopted son will become a doctor and find the cure!
lines.zh: : 可后来！突然之间，我第二个收养的儿子成了医生，找到了治愈的方法！

lines.en: : My wife will be healed and I will-
lines.zh: : 我妻子会康复，然后我会——

lines.en: : Karin.
lines.zh: : Karin。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate14
: Ah-
: You’re a bit of a daydreamer, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你还挺爱做白日梦的，是吧？

lines.en: : You seem to have put a lot of thought into your future for someone who is apparently having trouble figuring things out.
lines.zh: : 对一个明明说想不清楚未来的人来说，你似乎对自己的将来考虑得挺多的。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate9
: O-Okay...so {i}maybe{/i} I do get lost in daydreams from time to time...but so does every girl.
lines.zh: : 好、好吧……{i}也许{/i}我确实偶尔会陷进白日梦里……不过每个女孩都会这样。

lines.en: : We’re predictable. I understand how we work.
lines.zh: : 我们很好懂。我了解我们这套运作方式。

lines.en: : But when it comes to boys...I really have no idea.
lines.zh: : 可一碰到男生……我就完全摸不着头脑了。

lines.en: : I see them and my mind is just like “OH GOD! WHY DID I HAVE TO BE BORN WITH BROAD SHOULDERS?” and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我一看到他们，脑子里就只剩“哦天哪！我为什么偏偏生了一副宽肩膀？！”之类的念头。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate1
: But thanks for spending time with me regardless...even if it’s just to...develop a better relationship with the co-captain.
lines.zh: : 不过不管怎样，谢谢你愿意花时间陪我……哪怕只是为了……跟副队长搞好关系。

lines.en: I find it surprising that Karin is able to stay so humble despite having what so many other people work tirelessly to obtain.
lines.zh: 我很意外，Karin 明明拥有那么多别人拼了命都想要的东西，却还能保持这么谦逊。

lines.en: To see someone like her, who even [teenage]girls go out of their way to confess to, not realize how wonderful she is at first glance is truly a spectacle.
lines.zh: 像她这样的人，连 [teenage]女孩都会特地跑来跟她告白，她却第一眼看不出自己有多好——这可真是一大奇观。

lines.en: : I’m spending time with you because I want to spend time with you.
lines.zh: : 我花时间陪你，是因为我想花时间陪你。

lines.en: : You really shouldn’t say things like that to girls my age...We’ll get the wrong idea.
lines.zh: : 你真的不该对我这个年纪的女孩说这种话……我们会误会的。

lines.en: : Then get the wrong idea.
lines.zh: : 那就误会吧。

lines.en: : I’d really rather not. The wrong idea would give me a heart attack.
lines.zh: : 我真的不想。一误会我就要心脏病发作。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate9
: And I’ve already done a lot of running and blah blah blah blah blah boys are scary.
lines.zh: : 而且我今天已经跑了很多了，然后 blah blah blah，男生好可怕。

lines.en: : Everything is scary. Welcome to life.
lines.zh: : 什么都很可怕。欢迎来到人生。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate20
: Huh?
: Sorry. I almost let my cynical side slip out.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我差点把自己愤世嫉俗的那一面露出来了。

lines.en: : I don’t think you’ve had the misfortune of seeing that part of me yet.
lines.zh: : 我想你还没倒霉到见过我那一面。

lines.en: : Are you normally a cynical person?
lines.zh: : 你平时是个愤世嫉俗的人吗？

lines.en: : More or less.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。

lines.en: : I had no idea...
lines.zh: : 我都不知道……

lines.en: : I learned something about you today...
lines.zh: : 我今天了解到关于你的一件事……

lines.en: : It’s not a very exciting or interesting thing to learn, though.
lines.zh: : 不过这件事既不刺激也没意思。

lines.en: scene karinseconddate21
: I...learned a thing about a boy...
lines.zh: : 我……了解到关于一个男生的一件事……

lines.en: : ...Karin?
lines.zh: : ……Karin？

lines.en: scene karinseconddate1
: Ah! Sorry! I just got...weirdly happy all of a sudden!
lines.zh: : 啊！抱歉！我只是……突然莫名地开心起来了！

lines.en: : Totally not because we’re getting closer or anything! That would be like, {i}so{/i} weird, right?
lines.zh: : 绝对不是因为我们越来越亲近什么的！那也{i}太{/i}奇怪了吧，对吧？

lines.en: : Hahahahahah!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : So weird!
lines.zh: : 太奇怪了！

lines.en: : ...Right.
: Well, let’s call it here for today.
lines.zh: : 那么，今天就到这儿吧。

lines.en: : Did you maybe want to get dinner on the way home or something?
lines.zh: : 回家的路上要不要顺便吃个晚饭什么的？

lines.en: scene karinseconddate8
: Dinner?!
lines.zh: : 晚饭？！

lines.en: : I don’t know what that is!
lines.zh: : 我不知道那是什么！

lines.en: : I mean, I do know what it is!
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我知道那是什么！

lines.en: : I have no idea why I told you I didn’t!
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道自己为什么要说不知道！

lines.en: : I...umm!
scene karinseconddate11
: OKAY, SEE YOU!
lines.zh: : 好，再见！

lines.en: scene black
Karin nervously hops off of the bench and runs over to a small leather bag, picking it up and slinging it over her shoulder as she jogs out of the park.
lines.zh: Karin 紧张地从长椅上跳下来，跑到一只小皮包旁边，一把拎起甩到肩上，就这么小跑着出了公园。

lines.en: She’s still utterly terrified of me, sure, but at least she was able to smile more than normal today.
lines.zh: 没错，她还是怕我怕得要死，但至少今天她笑得比平时多了一些。

lines.en: I wonder how much longer it will be before she starts looking at me as a human being rather than a walking penis monster?
lines.zh: 我琢磨着，还要多久她才能把我当个人看，而不是一头行走的鸡巴怪物？

lines.en: But hey, that nervousness is one of her greatest charms.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，那份紧张正是她最大的魅力之一。

lines.en: The other of which is her thighs.
lines.zh: 另一个魅力则是她的大腿。

lines.en: Those two elements combine to make a wonderful human, and I’m glad that we get to spend time together like this...
lines.zh: 这两样加起来，造就了一个绝妙的人。我很高兴我们能像这样待在一起……

{i}Karin’s affection has increased to [karin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Karin 的好感度提升到了 [karin_love]!{/i}
